asks.message: CARDSVC profile: database_managers reads IBM Db2 for z/OS from this module's store, which is what this module proves and not what the estate has — which database systems the estate runs, and at which level
asks.request: List the database systems installed (Db2, IMS DL/I, IDMS, Adabas, ...) with their versions: the scan proves only what this module touches, which is a lower bound

asks.message: CARDSVC profile: environment_topology is not in the store — which LPARs and environments (production / test / DR) the estate has — the scanned JCL allocates datasets under the high-level qualifier(s) ASM, CARD, CICS, CICSTS, DSN, DSN910, PRTY, SYS1: a naming observation, which is not proof of which LPAR or environment runs them
asks.request: State the LPARs and environments, how a dataset or job name says which one it belongs to, and which sysplex they sit in: the scan can only list the qualifiers it saw

asks.message: CARDSVC profile: file_transfer is not in the store — how files cross the boundary of the estate — assumed 'IBM Connect:Direct' from mftb's typical-shop defaults until somebody confirms it
asks.request: State the file-transfer product (Connect:Direct, FTP/SFTP, XCOM, MFT) used to move datasets in and out

asks.message: CARDSVC profile: library_manager is not in the store — which source / change manager holds the members — assumed 'Broadcom Endevor' from mftb's typical-shop defaults until somebody confirms it
asks.request: State the source library manager (Endevor, ChangeMan, Panvalet, Librarian, plain PDS) and how a member is promoted to production

asks.message: CARDSVC profile: masking_policy is not in the store — what may leave the estate, and in what shape
asks.request: State the data-masking policy for extracted test data (which fields must be masked, whether production data may leave the estate at all)

asks.message: CARDSVC is built and run under 4 build paths: BP01 = CARD.PROD.FIXLIB > CARD.PROD.LOADLIB > CARD.PROD.COMMON.LOADLIB, PARM HOST(IBMCOB),APOST,SOURCE,XREF,STDSQL(NO); BP02 = CARD.PROD.FIXLIB > CARD.PROD.LOADLIB > CARD.PROD.COMMON.LOADLIB > CARD.PROD.LOADLIB, DB2 DSN910.SDSNLOAD > DSN910.SDSNEXIT > DSN910.RUNLIB.LOAD, PARM HOST(IBMCOB),APOST,SOURCE,XREF,STDSQL(NO); BP03 = CARD.PROD.LOADLIB > CARD.PROD.LOADLIB, DB2 DSN.V12R1.SDSNLOAD, PARM HOST(IBMCOB),APOST,SOURCE,XREF,STDSQL(NO); BP04 = DSN=CARD.PROD.LOADLIB,DISP=SHR — the module is not one unit of migration, each path is
asks.request: Confirm that the 4 build paths are intended (different DB2 level, load concatenation or compile options inside one module) and which one the migration targets

asks.message: CARDSVC profile: online_monitors reads IBM CICS Transaction Server from this module's store, which is what this module proves and not what the estate has — which transaction monitors the estate runs, and at which level
asks.request: List the online monitors installed (CICS TS, IMS TM, none) with their versions: the scan proves only what this module uses, which is a lower bound

asks.message: CARDSVC profile: output_manager is not in the store — which product owns the printed output once it leaves the spool — 178 DD(s) write to SYSOUT: the jobs print, but a spool class never names the product that archives or delivers the output — assumed 'Broadcom CA View' from mftb's typical-shop defaults until somebody confirms it
asks.request: State the output / report manager (CA View, CA Deliver, Control-D, CA Spool) and what it does with each SYSOUT class the jobs write to

asks.message: CARDSVC profile: security_manager is not in the store — which external security manager guards the datasets — assumed 'IBM RACF' from mftb's typical-shop defaults until somebody confirms it
asks.request: State the security manager (RACF, CA ACF2, CA Top Secret) and who owns the dataset profiles

asks.message: CARDSVC profile: sort_product is not in the store — which sort product PGM=SORT resolves to — 7 step(s) run PGM=SORT, the site linkage alias: a sort runs, the product is unnamed — assumed 'IBM DFSORT' from mftb's typical-shop defaults until somebody confirms it
asks.request: State the sort product installed (IBM DFSORT or Syncsort MFX): PGM=SORT is a linkage alias and does not say which one runs

asks.message: CARDSVC profile: standard_compiler is not in the store — which compiler the shop builds production code with — assumed 'IBM Enterprise COBOL for z/OS 6.3' from mftb's typical-shop defaults until somebody confirms it

asks.message: CARDSVC profile: standard_compiler_options is not in the store — which compile options the shop builds production code with — assumed 'RENT,NUMPROC(NOPFD),TRUNC(STD),ARCH(8),SSRANGE(NO)' from mftb's typical-shop defaults until somebody confirms it
asks.request: State the shop-standard compile options (NUMPROC, TRUNC, ARCH, RENT, SSRANGE, ...) a module is expected to be built with

asks.message: CARDSVC profile: tape_manager is not in the store — which tape manager owns the volumes the jobs allocate — assumed 'Broadcom CA 1' from mftb's typical-shop defaults until somebody confirms it
